body: Longtemps raillée outre-Manche lors de ses campagnes européennes, l'équipe de la capitale inspire désormais la méfiance au Royaume-Uni. body: Long mocked across the Channel during past continental campaigns, the French capital side now commands respect in the United Kingdom. British pundits approach this group-stage showdown wary of the Paris club, shedding their former tag as English football's easy target.
